thesis: The strongest short case is dilution plus execution complexity. Rocket Lab has negative standalone OCF, is developing Neutron, has issued billions of dollars of equity, and is attempting an $8B acquisition. A single integration or launch-program failure can impair the long-duration valuation. However, record backlog, large liquidity, Iridium cash generation, and multiple business lines prevent the exact Hard Veto predicates from being established.

evidence.claim: H1 2026 OCF was -$134.4M and H1 SBC $47.7M.
Iridium acquisition EV is about $8.0B while Neutron remains under development.

counterevidence: Q2 revenue +62% and backlog +137% show demand strength.
The acquisition financing is fully funded and the bridge was terminated.
falsifiers: Positive owner FCF/share after closing weakens the short thesis; renewed large dilution without per-share FCF progress strengthens it.

hard_veto_flags.veto: 경영진 정직성 또는 회계 신뢰성 훼손
hard_veto_flags.rationale: No restatement, auditor dispute or control failure is established.
Equity markets have been used aggressively, but current liquidity and fully funded acquisition financing do not establish structural emergency-financing dependence.
Dilution is severe but concentrated around strategic funding and has not yet satisfied the strict long-duration excessive-dilution predicate.
Backlog and mission-critical contracted demand show customer value.
Returns are immature, not proven structurally collapsed.
Launch cadence, backlog and product breadth do not show persistent moat shrinkage.

hard_veto_flags.veto: 현재가격이 비현실적인 Bull Case 이상을 요구
hard_veto_flags.rationale: Current price is below Base DCF and far below Bull.

hard_veto_flags.veto: 단일 제품·단일 고객·단일 규제에 대한 치명적 종속성
hard_veto_flags.rationale: Electron/Space Systems/Neutron/Iridium diversify the failure pathways; no single customer/product/regulation is fatal.

hard_veto_flags.veto: 파산 또는 영구손실 확률이 기대수익에 비해 지나치게 높음
hard_veto_flags.rationale: The funded transaction and Iridium cash generation reduce forced-financing/bankruptcy risk; execution downside remains but is not the exact V9 predicate.

next_checks: Transaction close, share count, Neutron schedule, combined FCF
